task.description: Produce the design artefact for REQ-227 (entity record-payload validation against a definition's derived schema), covering all 7 acceptance criteria and explicitly resolving the named open design question on JsonSchema namespace reuse.

result.note: Design doc written to lib/letflow/design/req227-entity-record-payload-validation.md. New module Letflow.Entities.Record.Validator (lib/letflow/entities/record/validator.ex) with build_record_schema/1 and validate_record_payload/2, mirroring REQ-225's Definition.Validator naming. Namespace open question resolved as option (a): call Letflow.EventStore.Registry.JsonSchema.validate/2 as-is via plain alias, cross-namespace, citing lib/letflow/definitions/json_schema_shape.ex's own existing precedent of naming JsonSchema.validate/2 as its consumer and JsonSchema's dependency-free-leaf status; extraction deferred per rule-of-three (flagged OQ-2 for REVIEWER). buildRecordSchema keyword mapping documents that minimum/maximum/maxLength are never emitted since REQ-225's field_def() carries no length/range constraint to translate (flagged OQ-1, not a keyword gap). Violation shape reused verbatim (Letflow.EventStore.Registry.ValidationFailure), no new struct. Self-checked: grepped the doc for defmodule/def/schema-do patterns, zero matches; all 7 fenced blocks are @type/@spec/annotated-map-shape illustrations only.
